description: This file defines the 'Operation' interface within the TensorFlow Java API, specifying methods for working with tensor operations, such as retrieving operation names, types, outputs, and input/output list lengths.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: An interface defining a TensorFlow computation operation, including methods to access operation metadata and tensor outputs.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the full name of the Operation.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the operation, indicating the named computation it performs.

methods.name: numOutputs
methods.description: Returns the number of tensors produced by this operation.

methods.name: outputListLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the list of Tensors produced by a specific named output.

methods.name: outputList
methods.description: Returns symbolic handles to a list of tensors produced by this operation.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns a symbolic handle to a single tensor produced by this operation, with type safety.

methods.name: inputListLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the list of input tensors associated with a named input for this operation.
